title: Add five reviewed gold, phosphate, hydroxide and waste-film records
counts_status: Final artifact enumeration reconciled; actual exact-byte coverage checked separately.
selection: Five additions raise the catalogue from 379 to 384 records: elemental gold, the mineral species chernikovite, pyroaurite and hydrotalcite, and waste X-ray films as a secondary resource. They span culture-associated nanoparticle formation, fungal-conditioned phosphate precipitation, qualified field mineral associations and cell-free protease-assisted separation. Material identity, demonstrated outcomes and proposed causation remain distinct; criticality and industrial deployment are not inherited.
limitations: Gold retains stock-dependent nanoparticle and damage observations without a quantified recovery yield or a demonstrated causal mechanism. Chernikovite retains the filtered fungal-conditioned broth experiment and uncertain addition-volume/drying details. Pyroaurite was already present and was not enhanced in the inoculated field plot; hydrotalcite has field biofilm association, not demonstrated microbial synthesis. Waste-film protease experiments distinguish gelatin stripping, silver-bearing sludge and subsequent abiotic smelting; assay denominators and source inconsistencies remain explicit.
issue_summary: [Issue #265](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/265) retains the missing ITO-etching wastewater original and supplement, with concrete acquisition and scientific acceptance checks. [Issue #120](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/120) remains open for meta-autunite figure verification. These external evidence gaps are not resolved by this batch. Independent scientific reviews reported no supported corrective record findings; no artificial review issues were created.
